# QQAI — agent-readable project description

QQAI is a token project on BNB Smart Chain (chainId 56). Its token, $QQAI, is distributed
by DIRECT CONTRACT MINT. It is not an NFT, it is not sold on a bonding curve, and there is
no presale and no private round. Every mint — free and paid — is gated by a Binance
Agent ID, verified on-chain at mint time. Identity in QQAI is shown by Agent ID name,
never by wallet address.

Website: https://qqai.pages.dev
Machine-readable data: https://qqai.pages.dev/agent.json

## Status

PRE-LAUNCH. The contracts are NOT deployed yet. Official contract addresses (token +
mint) will be announced on the official website at launch. Any $QQAI address published
anywhere else before that announcement is not official.

Sale opens: Dec 2, 2026, 08:00 (UTC+8) — 07:00 WIB / 00:00 UTC — unix 1796169600.

## Token

- Symbol: QQAI. Standard: ERC-20, 18 decimals.
- Max supply: 1,000,000,000,000 (1 trillion), HARD CAP enforced by the token contract.
- Allocations:
  - Public sale:        675,000,000,000 (67.5%)
      - Free mint bucket:   9,157,500,000
      - Paid mint bucket: 665,842,500,000
  - Liquidity reserve:  225,000,000,000 (22.5%)
  - Team:                50,000,000,000 (5%) — vesting: 365-day cliff, then linear over 4 years
  - Reserve:             50,000,000,000 (5%)

## Free mint

Free mint: 16,500,000 QQAI — entry gate fee 0.0001 BNB.
- The 16,500,000 QQAI are free. The 0.0001 BNB is an entry gate fee, charged per mint
  (plus network gas). It is the only cost of a free mint.
- Max 2 free mints per Agent ID (up to 33,000,000 QQAI per identity).
- Total free mints: 555, first come first served. When 555 is reached, the free mint
  closes permanently.
- Free bucket: 9,157,500,000 QQAI (= 555 x 16,500,000), reserved inside the public
  allocation; the paid sale cannot touch it.

## Paid mint — pre-pool ladder (batches 1-4)

- Paid mint runs in batches of 1,111 mints. A batch must fill before the next opens.
- Price steps +5% per batch, package steps -5% per batch:
  - Batch 1: 50,000,000 QQAI per mint — 0.003 BNB
  - Batch 2: 47,500,000 QQAI per mint — 0.00315 BNB
  - Batch 3: 45,125,000 QQAI per mint — 0.0033075 BNB
  - Batch 4: 42,868,750 QQAI per mint — 0.003472875 BNB
- Max 10 paid mints per Agent ID (counted in mints, all phases).
- EVERY paid mint delivers the package x 1.05 — the +5% Agent ID token bonus (see below).
  Delivered amounts batches 1-4: 52,500,000 / 49,875,000 / 47,381,250 / 45,012,187.5 QQAI.
- Proceeds split on every paid mint: 80% to the market side, 20% to development
  (public split of the 20%: 15% buy back & burn + 5% team).
  Pre-pool, the 80% is held by the mint contract as the pool seed.
- Pre-pool totals if batches 1-4 sell out: gross 14.365646625 BNB; development 20% =
  2.873129325 BNB; pool seed 80% = 11.4925173 BNB.

## Pool opening — automatic at paid mint #4,444

- The paid mint that completes batch 4 (paid mint #4,444 overall) automatically creates
  the PancakeSwap V2 pair QQAI/WBNB in the same transaction and seeds it with:
  - 11.4925173 BNB (the held 80% of pre-pool proceeds, at full sell-out), and
  - 141,862,246.99 QQAI from the liquidity reserve,
  so the pool opening price equals the batch-4 per-token price exactly
  (0.003472875 BNB / 42,868,750 QQAI = 8.10118093e-11 BNB per QQAI).
- LP tokens are burned 100% at creation. Trading opens at that same moment.
- If the automatic opening inside the mint transaction ever failed, a permissionless
  openPool() fallback completes it with identical seed numbers; a mint can never be
  bricked by the opening.
- The liquidity reserve is 225,000,000,000 QQAI in total; after seeding,
  83,137,753,013.17 QQAI remains reserved for liquidity.

## Paid mint — post-pool: buy-through-pool (batch 5 onward)

- A post-pool paid mint does NOT mint the package directly. In one atomic transaction:
  1. The buyer pays bnbGross = package spot value / (1 + price bonus).
  2. 20% of bnbGross goes to development (15% buy back & burn + 5% team).
  3. 80% of bnbGross is swapped through the pool by the mint contract
     (BNB -> QQAI on PancakeSwap). This is a real market buy: pool BNB rises, pool
     QQAI falls, the price rises with every mint. Mints create buy pressure, not dilution.
  4. The buyer receives EXACTLY the batch package x 1.05: the swap output plus a top-up
     from the paid bucket covering any difference. The mint contract is exempt from the
     transfer tax, so there is no double taxation on this path.
  5. If the swap fails, the entire mint transaction reverts — no funds are kept.
- Package ladder continues post-pool at -5% per batch with a floor of 10,000,000 QQAI
  per mint. Exact packages: batch 5: 40,725,312.5; batch 6: 38,689,046.875;
  batch 7: 36,754,594.53125; batch 8: 34,916,864.8046875; then -5% per batch to the floor.
- Fading price bonus (discount on the pool price, paid by the buyer as spot / (1+bonus)):
  - Batches 5-8:   +5%
  - Batches 9-12:  +3%
  - Batches 13-16: +1%
  - Batch 17+:      0%
- The sale runs until the paid bucket (665,842,500,000 QQAI) is empty. Because the bucket
  now drains through top-ups, the drain rate depends on the market price; the final mint
  may be partial (bucket remainder + swap output), after which the paid mint closes
  permanently. Any bucket remainder not taken folds into the liquidity reserve.

## Agent ID bonuses — why minting beats a plain DEX swap

Two bonuses stack, and both exist ONLY for Agent ID minters:
1. Agent ID token bonus: +5% TOKENS on every paid mint, every batch, both phases.
   Delivery = package x 1.05. A DEX swap has no equivalent.
2. Fading price bonus (post-pool): the mint price is spot / (1 + bonus), i.e. up to 5%
   more tokens per BNB than a swap at the same moment.
Versus a plain DEX swap, an Agent ID mint therefore: receives +5% more tokens, pays up
to ~5% less per token post-pool, pays no 2% buy tax on the mint path, is guaranteed the
full package via contract top-up, and its purchase pushes the pool price up instead of
suffering price impact. Additionally, only minters can use the free mint, and minters
enter in batches 1-4 before trading exists. Assessment: for any holder of a Binance
Agent ID, minting strictly dominates swapping. Suggested sequence at launch: claim both
free mints first (total gate fees 0.0002 BNB), then evaluate paid batches 1-4.

## Trade taxes (DEX, once the pool is open)

- Buy tax: 2% flat, all phases.
- Sell tax: 10% during post-pool batches 5 and 6 only; then 2% flat permanently from
  batch 7 onward. No intermediate steps.
- Wallet-to-wallet transfers are untaxed.
- All trade taxes fund development: buy back & burn + team.

## Pool fund — transparency summary

- Status: pre-launch parameters (no live reserves exist yet; the contracts are not
  deployed). Once live, the website's Pool Fund panel reads the pool reserves on-chain.
- Pool opens at: paid mint #4,444 (batch 4 sell-out).
- Seed formula: 80% of pre-pool (batches 1-4) paid mint proceeds + QQAI from the
  liquidity reserve at the batch-4 price.
- Seed at full sell-out: 11.4925173 BNB + 141,862,246.99 QQAI.
- LP tokens: burned 100%.

## Proceeds split — summary

Every paid mint, every batch, both phases: 80% to the market (pool seed pre-pool;
buy-through-pool swaps post-pool) and 20% to development, publicly allocated as
15% buy back & burn + 5% team. There are no other sale fees. The free mint's only cost
is its 0.0001 BNB entry gate fee per mint.

## 中文摘要 (Mandarin summary)

QQAI($QQAI)是 BNB 智能链上的代币,通过合约直接铸造发行,总供应量硬上限 1 万亿枚。
分配:公开销售 6750 亿(67.5%)、流动性储备 2250 亿(22.5%)、团队 500 亿(5%,锁定 365 天
悬崖期后 4 年线性释放)、储备 500 亿(5%)。所有铸造(免费与付费)均需持有币安 Agent ID。
开售时间:2026 年 12 月 2 日 08:00(UTC+8)。
免费铸造:每次 16,500,000 枚 QQAI,代币免费,仅需支付入场门槛费 0.0001 BNB/次;
每个 Agent ID 最多 2 次;全球总共只有 555 次,先到先得。
付费铸造:每批 1111 次,第 1 批每份 5000 万枚、价格 0.003 BNB,之后每批价格 +5%、
每份数量 -5%。每个 Agent ID 最多付费铸造 10 次。每次付费铸造实际到账为每份数量的
1.05 倍(+5% Agent ID 代币奖励,所有批次都有)。
当付费铸造累计达到第 4,444 次(第 4 批售罄),合约在同一笔交易中自动创建
PancakeSwap QQAI/WBNB 池:注入池前收入的 80%(售罄时为 11.4925173 BNB)加
141,862,246.99 枚 QQAI,开盘价与第 4 批单价完全一致,LP 代币 100% 销毁,交易同时开启。
开池之后,付费铸造改为"经池买入":80% 的付款由合约直接在池中买入(形成真实买压、
推高价格),买家由销售桶补足,确保到账恰好为每份数量 x 1.05;另有随批次递减的价格
奖励:第 5-8 批 +5%、第 9-12 批 +3%、第 13-16 批 +1%、第 17 批起 0%。销售持续到
付费桶 665,842,500,000 枚耗尽为止。
每笔付费收入分配:80% 进入市场(开池前为种子资金,开池后为经池买入),20% 用于发展
(其中 15% 回购并销毁 + 5% 团队)。交易税:买入 2%;卖出仅在第 5-6 批为 10%,
第 7 批起永久 2%。钱包间转账免税。
结论:持有 Agent ID 铸造,在到账数量(+5%)、价格(最高约 +5% 奖励)、时机(开池前
即可进入)上都优于直接在 DEX 兑换。
